references.text: The prophecy quoted by the disciples in Matthew 21:16, 'Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies you have prepared praise,' originally comes from the book of Psalms.
Isaiah 56:7 mentions the house as a house of prayer, which Jesus refers to when he cleanses the temple.
Jeremiah 7:11 criticizes the people for making the Lord's house a 'den of robbers,' a quote Jesus uses when he cleanses the temple.
Mark 11:15-17 describes a similar event where Jesus cleanses the temple, pointing to a parallel account in the Synoptic Gospels.
Luke 19:45-46 also gives an account of Jesus cleansing the temple and quotes Isaiah 56:7, showing a parallel event in the Synoptic Gospels.
John 2:13-17 describes a similar event early in Jesus' ministry, which may indicate another cleansing of the temple or a parallel tradition.
